look: XORA site look, same as the V00 welcome film: deep void ground, frosted glass panels with thin cyan-to-violet edges, fictional market lines drawing in, calm eased motion, the brain tutor guiding from the bottom-right corner

scenes.name: Lesson twelve
scenes.desc: Title card: Phase 3, lesson T12, Margin and Leverage; a lever balances a small margin block against a big exposure block; the tutor walks in.

scenes.name: Same move, different results
scenes.desc: Two traders put 100 USDT into a BTC long, one at 1x and one at 10x; BTC rises 2% then falls 2% below the start; their PnL meters move 2 against 20 USDT.

scenes.name: Margin is a deposit
scenes.desc: Initial margin defined: 100 USDT moves from a 500 USDT futures wallet into a locked margin box; rental-car deposit analogy.

scenes.name: Notional exposure
scenes.desc: Notional defined: a 100 USDT margin block and a 1,000 USDT position bar; about 0.0167 BTC at 60,000 USDT.

scenes.name: Leverage
scenes.desc: Leverage = notional / margin: a selector steps 1x, 3x, 10x while the margin bar stays 100 and the notional bar grows to 300 and 1,000; magnifying-glass analogy.

scenes.name: One path, three leverages
scenes.desc: One fictional price path (60,000 to 61,200 to 58,800) drives three PnL meters at 1x, 3x and 10x: +2/+6/+20 then -2/-6/-20 USDT.

scenes.name: Worked example
scenes.desc: Gross PnL = notional x signed % move: 1,000 x (-2%) = -20 USDT; return on margin -20 / 100 = -20%.

scenes.name: Both directions
scenes.desc: BTC falls 10%: at 1x the margin falls from 100 to 90; at 10x the whole 100 is gone on paper; liquidation would come before that, at a point set by exchange rules.

scenes.name: Maintenance margin
scenes.desc: Maintenance margin defined; a margin-balance gauge (margin + unrealized PnL) sinks toward an unnumbered line set by the exchange.

scenes.name: Isolated and cross
scenes.desc: Isolated margin: a loss drains only the 100 USDT assigned to the position. Cross margin: the same loss can draw on the whole 500 USDT futures balance.

scenes.name: Common mistake
scenes.desc: Misconception: leverage is free extra money. Correction: it is extra exposure; losses on the full notional come out of your margin; no leverage is safe.

scenes.name: Try it
scenes.desc: Pause and calculate: 50 USDT margin, 5x, BTC +4%: notional 250 USDT, PnL +10 USDT, +20% of margin; a 4% fall would be -10 USDT.

scenes.name: Know the risks
scenes.desc: Magnified losses, liquidation, costs on the notional, no safe leverage; WAIT and NO_TRADE are always allowed.

scenes.name: Recap
scenes.desc: Three key points and one check question: 100 USDT at 10x, BTC -3% gives -30 USDT.

scenes.name: Up next
scenes.desc: End card: next lesson T13, Liquidation, Funding and Futures Risks.
